grammar.title: Still, as before with 仍然
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 仍然 + 动词/形容词短语
grammar.explanation: 仍然 (réngrán) means "still, as before" — it shows that a situation hasn't changed even though something might have been expected to change it. It's more formal than 还.

grammar.title: Worth doing with 值得
grammar.explanation: 值得 (zhídé) means "to be worth (doing)" — followed directly by a verb, it says an action is worthwhile. It's often used to recommend something, like a book, a movie, or a way of doing things.
